tools.name: x_user_info
tools.description: Get user profile. Public profile of a user by screen name.

tools.name: x_user_about
tools.description: Get user 'about' details. Extra profile details of a user (account location, creation info, verification details).

tools.name: x_user_batch_info_by_ids
tools.description: Get users by IDs. Profiles of up to 20 users in one request.

tools.name: x_user_search
tools.description: Search users. Search users by keyword. Paginated: use `cursor` / `next_cursor`.

tools.name: x_user_last_tweets
tools.description: Get user's latest tweets. Latest tweets of a user, newest first. The list is inside `data.tweets`. Pass either `userName` or `userId`. Paginated: use `cursor` / `next_cursor`.

tools.name: x_user_tweet_timeline
tools.description: Get user's tweet timeline. Tweet timeline of a user by numeric user ID. The list is inside `data.tweets`. Paginated: use `cursor` / `next_cursor`.

tools.name: x_user_mentions
tools.description: Get user mentions. Tweets that mention a user. Paginated: use `cursor` / `next_cursor`.

tools.name: x_user_articles
tools.description: Get user's articles. Articles (long-form posts) published by a user. The list is inside `data.articles`. Paginated: use `cursor` / `next_cursor`.

tools.name: x_user_followers
tools.description: Get followers. Followers of a user with full profiles. Up to 100 per page. Paginated: use `cursor` / `next_cursor`.

tools.name: x_user_followings
tools.description: Get followings. Accounts a user follows, with full profiles. Up to 100 per page. Paginated: use `cursor` / `next_cursor`.

tools.name: x_user_followers_ids
tools.description: Get follower IDs. Follower user IDs only, 200 per page. Pass either `userName` or `userId`. Paginated: use `cursor` / `next_cursor`.

tools.name: x_user_verified_followers
tools.description: Get verified followers. Verified followers of a user by numeric user ID. Paginated: use `cursor` / `next_cursor`.

tools.name: x_user_check_follow_relationship
tools.description: Check follow relationship. Whether two users follow each other.

tools.name: x_tweets
tools.description: Get tweet by ID. One tweet by its numeric ID. Exactly one ID per request.

tools.name: x_tweet_advanced_search
tools.description: Advanced search. Search tweets with the X advanced search syntax, e.g. `from:NASA since:2026-01-01`. Paginated: use `cursor` / `next_cursor`.

tools.name: x_tweet_replies
tools.description: Get tweet replies. Replies to a tweet. Paginated: use `cursor` / `next_cursor`.

tools.name: x_tweet_replies_v2
tools.description: Get tweet replies (sortable). Replies to a tweet, with a choice of ordering via `queryType`. Paginated: use `cursor` / `next_cursor`.

tools.name: x_tweet_thread_context
tools.description: Get thread context. The conversation thread a tweet belongs to. Paginated: use `cursor` / `next_cursor`.

tools.name: x_tweet_quotes
tools.description: Get quote tweets. Tweets that quote a tweet. Paginated: use `cursor` / `next_cursor`.

tools.name: x_tweet_retweeters
tools.description: Get retweeters. Users who retweeted a tweet. Paginated: use `cursor` / `next_cursor`.

tools.name: x_article
tools.description: Get article. An article (long-form post) by its tweet ID.

tools.name: x_list_tweets
tools.description: Get list tweets. Tweets from members of a list. Paginated: use `cursor` / `next_cursor`.

tools.name: x_list_tweets_timeline
tools.description: Get list timeline. Timeline of a list. Paginated: use `cursor` / `next_cursor`.

tools.name: x_list_members
tools.description: Get list members. Members of a list. Paginated: use `cursor` / `next_cursor`.

tools.name: x_list_followers
tools.description: Get list followers. Followers of a list. Paginated: use `cursor` / `next_cursor`.

tools.name: x_community_info
tools.description: Get community. Details of a community.

tools.name: x_community_members
tools.description: Get community members. Members of a community. Paginated: use `cursor` / `next_cursor`.

tools.name: x_community_moderators
tools.description: Get community moderators. Moderators of a community. Paginated: use `cursor` / `next_cursor`.

tools.name: x_community_tweets
tools.description: Get community tweets. Tweets posted in a community. Paginated: use `cursor` / `next_cursor`.

tools.name: x_community_search_tweets
tools.description: Search tweets across communities. Search tweets posted in any community. Paginated: use `cursor` / `next_cursor`.

tools.name: x_trends
tools.description: Get trends. Trending topics for a location.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: x_user_articles, x_tweet_thread_context, x_article · Public sink: x_user_tweet_timeline, x_tweets, x_tweet_advanced_search, x_tweet_replies, x_tweet_replies_v2, x_tweet_thread_context, x_tweet_quotes, x_tweet_retweeters, x_article.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: x_user_articles, x_tweet_thread_context, x_article · Public sink: x_user_tweet_timeline, x_tweets, x_tweet_advanced_search, x_tweet_replies, x_tweet_replies_v2, x_tweet_thread_context, x_tweet_quotes, x_tweet_retweeters, x_article

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
